heading: Eligible affordable housing activities

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Affordable housing activities under this section are activities conducted in accordance with the requirements of section 4230 of this title to—

children.text: develop or to support affordable housing for rental or homeownership; or
provide housing services with respect to affordable housing, through the activities described in subsection (b).

tree.heading: Activities
tree.text: The activities described in this subsection are the following:

children.heading: Development
children.text: The acquisition, new construction, reconstruction, or moderate or substantial rehabilitation of affordable housing, which may include—
real property acquisition;
site improvement;
the development of utilities and utility services;
conversion;
demolition;
financing;
administration and planning; and
other related activities.

children.heading: Housing services
children.text: The provision of housing-related services for affordable housing, including—
housing counseling in connection with rental or homeownership assistance;
the establishment and support of resident organizations and resident management corporations;
energy auditing;
activities related to the provisions of self-sufficiency and other services; and
other services related to assisting owners, tenants, contractors, and other entities participating or seeking to participate in other housing activities assisted pursuant to this section.

children.heading: Housing management services
children.text: The provision of management services for affordable housing, including—
the preparation of work specifications;
loan processing;
inspections;
tenant selection;
management of tenant-based rental assistance; and
management of affordable housing projects.

children.heading: Crime prevention and safety activities
children.text: The provision of safety, security, and law enforcement measures and activities appropriate to protect residents of affordable housing from crime.

children.heading: Model activities
children.text: Housing activities under model programs that are—
designed to carry out the purposes of this subchapter; and
specifically approved by the Secretary as appropriate for the purpose referred to in subparagraph (A).

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 106–568, § 203, and Pub. L. 106–569, § 513, enacted identical sections 810 of Pub. L. 104–330. This section is based on the text of section 810 of Pub. L. 104–330, as added by Pub. L. 106–569, § 513.
